* Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, or a related field

	+ Power BI Stack: Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Premium capacities, Gateway architecture, Deployment Pipelines
	+ Data Modelling: Master\-level understanding of dimensional modelling, fact/dimension tables, handling slowly changing dimensions (SCDs), and solving granular calculation challenges
	+ Optimization: solid hands\-on usage of DAX Studio, and Performance Analyzer to eliminate visual bottlenecks and reduce dataset sizes
* AI Integration \& Advanced Programming
	+ Intermediate\-to\-advanced Python (Pandas, Scikit\-learn, Seaborn) or R for executing predictive workloads inside Power BI
* Data Warehousing \& SQL
	+ Advanced SQL: Expert\-level query formulation, indexing strategies, CTEs, and window functions to prep data before it hits the Power BI ingestion layer
